languages.text: the languages it knew in life

text.formatted: As a bonus action, the will-o'-wisp can target one creature it can see within 5 feet of it that has 0 hit points and is still alive. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw against this magic or die. If the target dies, the will-o'-wisp regains 10 (3d6) hit points.
text.plain: As a bonus action, the will-o'-wisp can target one creature it can see within 5 feet of it that has 0 hit points and is still alive. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw against this magic or die. If the target dies, the will-o'-wisp regains 10 (3d6) hit points.

text.formatted: The will-o'-wisp can't wear or carry anything.
text.plain: The will-o'-wisp can't wear or carry anything.

text.formatted: The will-o'-wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
text.plain: The will-o'-wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

text.formatted: The will-o'-wisp sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The will-o'-wisp can alter the radius as a bonus action.
text.plain: The will-o'-wisp sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. The will-o'-wisp can alter the radius as a bonus action.

text.formatted: Melee Spell Attack:_ +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. _Hit:_ 9 (2d8) lightning damage.
text.plain: Melee Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit:_ 9 (2d8) lightning damage.

text.formatted: The will-o'-wisp and its light magically become Invisible until it attacks or uses its Consume Life, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).
text.plain: The will-o'-wisp and its light magically become Invisible until it attacks or uses its Consume Life, or until its concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell).
